onboarding.title: Home services, closer to you
onboarding.subtitle: A place for homeowners and local professionals. Choose how you will use Salhly to get started.
onboarding.customer_benefit: Explore service categories and keep your account details in one place.
onboarding.provider_benefit: Build your service profile and submit a work credential for review.
onboarding.email_note: Continue with your email and a password. You can review your account type before signing up.
onboarding.availability_note: Service requests, quotes, and job tracking are coming later.

auth.log_in_subtitle: Sign in to your home-service workspace.
auth.sign_up_subtitle: Tell us your name and how you plan to use Salhly.
auth.session_subtitle: Checking your account before opening your workspace.
auth.session_failed_subtitle: Your workspace could not be opened. Try again or sign out.
auth.name: Full name
auth.name_length: Use a name between 2 and 80 characters.
auth.email_exists: This email is already registered. Sign in instead.
auth.email_not_confirmed: Confirm your email before signing in.
auth.provider_hint: After signing in, add your skills, service areas, and a credential for review. Creating an account does not verify you.
auth.password_too_short: Use a password with at least 8 characters.
auth.same_password: Choose a password different from your current one.
auth.invalid_credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
auth.forgot_password_subtitle: Enter your account email. If the account is eligible, you will receive a code to reset your password.
auth.code_invalid: Enter the 6 to 8 digit code from your email.
auth.invalid_code: This code is invalid or expired. Request a new one.
auth.code_sent: If the account is eligible, a new code has been sent. Check your inbox and spam folder.
auth.verify_email_subtitle: Enter the code from your signup email. You need to confirm your email before entering the app.
auth.reset_password_subtitle: Enter the recovery code from your email and choose a new password.
auth.choose_password: Your recovery code is verified. Set a new password to continue.
auth.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment before trying again.
auth.demo_code: Demo only: use code {code}. No email is sent.

home.discovery_card_body: From everyday repairs to fresh starts, explore the service your home needs.
home.provider_card_title: Make room for your next opportunity.
home.provider_card_body: Add your skills, service areas, and a work credential to get your profile ready.
home.customer_subtitle: Find the right service for your home.
home.provider_subtitle: Your local service workspace starts here.
home.category_soon: Service request creation is planned for the next marketplace milestone. You can browse categories now; no booking is made here.
home.step_request: Describe the service you need and share the details.
home.step_quotes: Receive and compare quotes from eligible professionals.
home.step_choose: Choose a provider and follow your job through completion.
home.provider_next: Open provider setup to add your services, weekly hours, and a credential for review. Job browsing and quotes will follow.

notifications.title: Your notifications
notifications.empty_message: Important account and service updates will appear here.
notifications.not_found: This notification is no longer available. Refresh your inbox.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.phone_invalid: Enter a valid phone number, up to 32 characters.
profile.city_length: Use a city name up to 100 characters.
profile.role_note: Your role is set at sign-up and cannot be edited here.
profile.provider_note: Creating a provider account does not verify your credentials. Open provider setup to view your review status.
profile.demo_note: Profile changes are local to this demo and are cleared on restart.

provider.title: Provider setup
provider.about_hint: Describe your experience and the work you offer. Use 20 to 1,000 characters before submitting for review.
provider.skills_hint: Choose at least one service. These are self-reported skills, not individual certifications.
provider.areas_hint: Add up to 10 cities or districts, one per line. Use clear area names, not a private home address.
provider.hours_hint: Choose at least one day in each service area's local time. These are not bookable slots. End time must follow start time; midnight as an end time means the end of that day.
provider.saved: Your provider details have been saved.
provider.unsaved: Unsaved changes. A selected document is uploaded only when you submit.
provider.discard_message: Your last saved details will remain. Unsaved edits and the selected document will be removed from this page.
provider.wait_operation: Wait for the current save or submission to finish before leaving.

status_hint.draft: Save your professional details, then send one credential for review. Your account is not verified.
status_hint.pending: Submission is not approval. Your submitted details are read-only until an authorized reviewer makes a decision.
status_hint.verified: An authorized reviewer approved your submitted credential. Service details remain self-reported. Booking and job access are not available yet.
status_hint.rejected: Read the review note, update your details, and submit a new document when ready.

provider.document_hint: One clear JPEG or PNG image, up to 5 MiB. Use a relevant trade certificate or professional credential. PDF files are not supported yet.
provider.privacy_note: Private to you and authorized reviewers. Avoid unnecessary personal information. This prototype is for sample documents until the operator publishes a privacy and retention policy.
provider.demo_note: Demo only: the sample document stays in this app's memory and resets on restart. No real review or approval takes place.
provider.consent: I agree to share this document and my submitted profile with authorized reviewers for credential verification.
provider.submitted: Your submission is saved and awaiting review. It is not approval.

errors.access: Only the signed-in provider can access this setup. Sign in again if your session changed.
errors.invalid_profile: Check your provider details and try again.
errors.bio: Use an introduction between 20 and 1,000 characters before review.
errors.skills: Choose 1 to 20 available services. Remove any unavailable service before saving.
errors.areas: Use 1 to 10 unique area names, each between 2 and 100 characters.
errors.availability: Choose at least one day with an end time after its start time. Split overnight hours across separate days.
errors.incomplete: Complete your introduction, services, areas, and weekly hours before submitting.
errors.consent: Agree to the review before submitting this document.
errors.locked: This submission is already under review or approved. Check review status before trying again.
errors.document_required: Choose a document image before submitting.
errors.document_unavailable: This document could not be opened. Check review status and try again.
errors.document_type: Choose a valid JPEG or PNG image. Other file types are not supported.
errors.document_size: Choose a non-empty document image no larger than 5 MiB.
errors.upload: The upload or submission could not be confirmed. Check review status before retrying.
errors.pick: The image picker could not be opened. Try again and check photo access if needed.
errors.cleanup: The upload outcome is uncertain and cleanup could not be confirmed. Check review status before retrying; an operator may need to remove an unused upload.

errors.network: Could not connect. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.auth_failed: Authentication could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.request_failed: Your request could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.database_setup: Your account data is not ready. Run the Salhly migrations in SETUP.md in order, then try again.
errors.not_authenticated: Please sign in again to continue.
errors.invalid_profile: Check your profile details and try again.
errors.storage: Could not save the local session settings. Please try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
